leads.name: Grand Oak, Philippe Park
leads.location: Philippe Park, Safety Harbor (Pinellas County parks)
leads.reason: A tree-service blog says over 300 years; a travel write-up says maybe 200+; no register, no coordinate, no dated source. Needs Pinellas County Parks source and a pin.

leads.name: Lover's Oak, Safety Harbor
leads.reason: Seen only as a Waymarking listing title (wm127J6); not read. Candidate for the Safety Harbor cluster with the Baranoff Oak.

leads.name: Lutz laurel oak, Florida champion
leads.reason: Champion layer pk 957 (circumference 216 in, height 84 ft, 2013), but it stands between two houses on private ground; no public access.
